    Today: as Bloom and its partners publish it. Proposed: what the experience layer adds.

    Five principles for every Bloom experience.

    Connected

    Related, never isolated.

    A handover leads straight into community life.

    Effortless

    Complexity stays behind the experience.

    Share details once, not again for each part of Bloom.

    Recognisable

    Always Bloom, even under a partner's brand.

    The EDITION stays the EDITION. Bloom is still felt around it.

    Relevant

    What matters to this person, at this moment.

    An owner waiting for handover sees progress first.

    Human

    Technology serves the relationship.

    A real person is one step away when it matters.

    Simpler for people.
